svg.text: Heart Disease Classification | Model Development • CI/CD • Deployment • Monitoring
Dataset preparation, evaluation and experiment tracking
Version control and repeatable automated validation
Containerized prediction service running on local Minikube
Scraped metrics and a Grafana dashboard for runtime visibility
Repeatable checks from a clean setup
Pass / fail status and execution logs
Access with curl or Swagger UI
HTTP request counters and status codes
Scrapes the API Service every 15 seconds
Charts update as requests are made
CI/CD validates source changes; the deployed API exposes metrics that Prometheus scrapes for Grafana.
Educational heart-disease classifier • Local Minikube deployment • Not for clinical diagnosis
